sharedGrantContract.timing: After the approved animal-selection sequence completes, commit one fixed power grant and its animal bindings before freezing that completion reaction and returning to archetype. It is a fixed reveal, not another spin.
sharedGrantContract.idempotence: One grant per source Siluman race component; runId + ruleId + sourceSilumanComponentId is the consumed key. Rendering/replay and additional animal components do not create more copies.
sharedGrantContract.laterAnimal: A newly authorized animal result for the same source component extends the recorded bindings; no new grant or mastery respin.
sharedGrantContract.mainPowerNone: Keep this power and resolve its pending normal Power Mastery even when main Power is None.
sharedGrantContract.lateGrant: After the Power stage, bind this grant to existing shared Power Mastery without another spin. If no result exists because mastery was skipped for empty inventory, invoke the first/only shared draw, then return to caller.
sharedGrantContract.otherRacialForms: Having several animals does not automatically grant partial/fused forms, other themed powers, stat points, or source-hero identity.

contextContract.asOfRule: Each animal reaction sees committed components only. The transformation grant context is available after the fixed grant commits; before then do not describe a pending power as owned.
contextContract.completion: Freeze the last animal-selection completion reaction after the shared power grant so its actual grant and allowed animal forms can be narrated.
contextContract.fixedGrant: Attach the grant reveal to completion. No random result or extra wheel is fabricated.
contextContract.animalSpecificGrant: A committed Babi result includes its Nyolong fixed grant before that reaction freezes. Other animal results grant no Nyolong.
contextContract.babiNarrationExample: Babi dapet Nyolong. Barang lu aman? Coba cek lagi.
